command: import sympy as s; x,y,z,t=s.symbols("x y z t",real=True); r0=s.symbols("r0",positive=True); v=s.Matrix([x,y,z]); flow=(1-t/s.sqrt(v.dot(v)))*v; actual=s.simplify(flow.jacobian(v).subs({x:r0,y:0,z:0})); expected=s.diag(1,1-t/r0,1-t/r0); print("actual",actual); print("expected",expected); print("structural_equality",actual==expected); differences=[s.simplify(d) for d in actual-expected]; print("entrywise_differences",differences); print("determinant",s.factor(actual.det())); assert all(d==0 for d in differences)
